blocks.text: French boxer Christian Mbilli said Thursday he is “coming for the win” when he takes to the ring to defend his WBC super-middleweight title against Saul ‘Canelo’ Alvarez. He will meet the 36-year-old Mexican legend on Saturday in Riyadh. “I can’t wait to be in the ring. I am ready for this fight, I am ready to shock the world,” Mbilli said.
